items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: He played the piano and I'd sing maybe a song or so.

ctx.x: I mean? I don't know why, but he was that just kind of a fella, I guess.

Anyway, getting back to where we entertained for the Indian Trucks, there was a fella called Humboldt Collins -- he was the manager of the Indiana Truck Company -- we used to advertise his trucks and he used to take us around to different parties, places to play for him, which was magnificent. Then we'd play the (inaudible) in the Waterson motel in Kentucky, the biggest hotels that were there, you know. We played in the Five and Ten Cents Store.
